verdict: Meta delivered leads efficiently; Google spend produced zero conversions this period.
narrative: This period, you received 86 leads at an average cost of $35.73 per lead, all driven by Meta — a strong result on $801 in Meta spend. Google Ads ran in parallel at $2,271 over the same 28 days and recorded zero conversions, meaning that budget produced no measurable lead output. Compounding this, both channels went dark for four of the last six days in the reporting window, which stopped lead flow entirely at the end of the period. Google campaign targeting and conversion tracking are being reviewed now to stop spend that isn't producing, and both channels are being brought back live. Expect steadier daily lead flow next period as those fixes take effect.
